Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The sign gallery pages (physical pages two hundred twenty-two to two hundred twenty-four) extracted only sign captions with no images or rules, and two pages in the appendix extracted only page numbers; no fact is taken from them (verify NJ-SIGN-D-GALLERY).
The sign color and shape table extracted one row per line with color, shape, side count and message together, so its rows are used as printed [A04].
Sign recognition needs official sign images; part C declares a dedicated visual surface, and the images must come from an official source rather than from the extracted text.
The appendix opener page carries only a title and is not used.
